target_customer: Consumer leisure travelers, especially frequent flyers, plus travel advisors
problem: Researching and booking flights, hotels and activities across many tabs is slow. Stardrift is an AI planner that finds options, tracks bookings and builds itineraries.
business_model: Free consumer app; monetization not stated (likely booking commissions or advisor tools)

founders.name: Leila Clark
founders.background_notes: YC page: software engineer at Jane Street, graduated Princeton with highest honors. CB Insights snippet says 2018 graduation (single source). An Employbl profile also names Trevor Chow, not confirmed by YC page, so not listed.

technical_complexity.rationale: LLM planning on top of flight and hotel search APIs with a mobile app; hard parts are live pricing data and booking reliability, but a 3 person team can build a prototype.

defensibility.rationale: Planning interface is easy to copy and general assistants and OTAs can add the same features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Expedia and Booking launched AI trip planning features (SCMP coverage) and ChatGPT is listed as an alternative in roundups; no acquisition of Stardrift found.

market_need_then: Travel planning is fragmented and 2024 saw several funded AI trip planners and OTA entrants, indicating investor belief in demand but unproven willingness to pay.

branding.domain_note: Uses stardrift.ai; legal entity is Kopfkino, Inc. per site footer.

identity.logo: wordmark; dotted background motif on site
identity.visual_style: Clean with app screenshots and map views
identity.voice_and_tone: Friendly and practical; 'The AI travel planner in your pocket'.

branding.community_and_virality: Product Hunt launches; mostly directory listings, no sign of organic community.

brand_strength.rationale: Pleasant evocative name but no brand press; mostly directory coverage.

outcome_analysis: Stardrift is active with a free iOS app and web product, listed as live since December 2025 by one review site, and a 3 person team. No funding, acquisition or shutdown news was found, so the outcome is undetermined; the main structural risk is that the product is a thin layer easily copied by larger platforms.
notes: Unverified: Employbl/Diffbot and Standout list a 500K pre-seed with no named investors, aggregator only. CB Insights fetch returned 403. Name origin and rebrands not found. Founding year conflict (YC 2024, Employbl 2025). Funding cross-check not possible beyond aggregators.
